==Introduction==

Vending machines - commonly referred to as ''Vends'' - are essential infrastructure commonly located in various POIs or Outposts throughout the Frontier. These automated dispensers offer a wide selection of items, ranging from classic tools, uniforms, to fuel, and non-lethal to less-lethal weaponry. Each vending machine serves a particular purpose or department to ensure efficient access without direct oversight.

Some particular vending machines provide specific quotes in reaction to passerbys or consumers. This page provides an exhaustive list of all vending machines located on the Frontier.
